verdict.rationale: Stagehand documents some control over whether browser state is kept: a configurable local user-data directory that persists cookies and local storage across runs, and Browserbase contexts for opt-in persistence. That gives users a thin form of retention control. However, server-side caching of act/observe/extract results is documented with no retention or deletion controls, and no deletion API or retention-policy settings are evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit deletion controls for cached and session data, configurable retention periods, documented controls over server-side cache and session-recording retention, and independent corroboration.
